newsitem.title: USA: Tandy plans to add 1,000 RadioShack dealerships.
newsitem.headline: Tandy plans to add 1,000 RadioShack dealerships.

text.p: Tandy Corp., the consumer electronics giant, said Thursday it plans to add up to 1,000 new RadioShack dealerships over the next five years under a new programme called RadioShack Select.
Tandy said the 1,000 new stores would increase the total number of RadioShack dealerships to more than 7,800 nationwide.

It said RadioShack Select is a package concept designed to entice new dealers in cities and towns that are not located near another RadioShack store and have a population of between 1,500 and 15,000 people.
The initial investment for a packaged dealership is less than $60,000, including merchandise, fixtures, signs and franchise fees, Tandy said.
Tandy sells its products through 6,800 RadioShack and 92 Computer City outlets, the company said.
